summary: No security-relevant attack surface introduced by this task. Changes are limited to immutable model records (ContentBlock/MediaItem/BlockType), an enum value swap (StepType), the FunnelStep field/copyOf refactor, and a comment update in FunnelExecutionFactory. There is no user-input parsing, no DB query construction, no external API call, no auth/authorization logic, and no deserialization configuration change in this diff. ContentBlock/MediaItem are persisted as nested documents without a Mongo _class discriminator (mirrors existing Button/FunnelStep flat-POJO pattern, Decision 12) — no polymorphic-deserialization gadget surface is added. OWASP-relevant controls (anti-SSRF on media URLs, XSS escaping in preview, callback IDOR/owner checks) are explicitly and correctly deferred to Tasks 4/5 and documented in the model Javadoc; deferring them here is the spec-sanctioned design, not a gap in this task.
notes: Reviewer self-conducted by the implementing agent (Agent/Task spawn tool unavailable in this environment). Methodology (security-auditor / OWASP Top 10) applied directly against the diff.

OWASP categories assessed and found out-of-scope-or-clean for this diff: A01 Broken Access Control (no authz here), A03 Injection/XSS (no rendering/queries here; preview escaping is Task 4), A08 Software/Data Integrity (no insecure deserialization config; flat POJO, no _class), A10 SSRF (no URL dereference; media stays URL/file_id, validated in Task 4). No secrets, no logging of sensitive data added.
